# Signal

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Sets bits on an event and wakes waiters.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x09` SVC_SIGNAL | — | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err Signal(Handle ev_handle, EventWord bits, bool broadcast);
```

**Registers:** `(event, bits, flags) -> r0 status`

Without `broadcast`, the highest-priority waiter wakes and receives the accumulated bits; with it, all waiters wake. With no waiter, the bits stay set for the next WaitOn().

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ev_handle` | in | Event handle with PERM_SEND. |
| `bits` | in | Bits to set; bit 31 is reserved. |
| `broadcast` | in | Wake every waiter instead of one. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | Bit 31 is set. |
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `ev_handle` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `ev_handle` lacks PERM_SEND, or a bit is claimed by a binding. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `ev_handle` is not an event. |
| [`ERR_DEAD`](../errors.md#err_dead) | The event has been destroyed. |
